# Native Highlight verification after #118

Eight unchanged synthetic native stages retained from issue #124 on 2026-10-22.
See [the verification record](../../../../docs/issue-124-highlight-verification.md)
for exact candidate/executable identity, operator actions, screenshots and results.

**Admission failed:** Monight comment-only edits alter some colour channels and
appearance streams. New Highlight creation is suspended pending the follow-up.
Placement, Page Rotation, editability, saved comments and attached replies pass.

- `input.pdf`: unmarked two-page input, page rotations 0 and 90; generated by
  `create-fixture.py` using ReportLab/pypdf.
- `monight-created-snapshot.pdf`: five production colours on each page, created
  and natively saved through the packaged Monight UI.
- `preview-edited-snapshot.pdf`: ten native Preview comment edits.
- `preview-monight-final.pdf`: ten Monight re-edits, reopened in native Preview.
- `acrobat-edited-snapshot.pdf`: owner-authored Acrobat replies attached to two
  Monight Highlights, plus two native Acrobat heading Highlights.
- `acrobat-monight-final.pdf`: Monight parent-comment edits and comments on both
  Acrobat-created marks; reopened in Acrobat. Both attached replies survive.
- `preview-origin-snapshot.pdf`: five genuinely Preview-created colours on each
  page. Preview omits annotation /NM identifiers.
- `preview-origin-monight-final.pdf`: Monight comments on all ten native Preview
  marks; reopened in Preview on both pages.

`candidate-config.json` contains only the verification product name/identifier.
`SHA256SUMS` pins all eight PDFs. With pypdf installed, run `python3 verify.py` to
verify page content/boxes/rotation, geometry, exact comments/replies, counts and
the reproduced colour discrepancy. `python3 verify.py --require-admission`
intentionally fails until this candidate's colour-preservation failure is fixed.
Original page content and saved stages are never repaired by the verifier.
